title: Circuit size and paired encoding length
statement: For any natural number $n$ and Boolean circuit tree $C$ on $n$ variables, the size of $C$ is at most the length of the encoding formed by concatenating the unary encoding of $n$ with the Boolean-list encoding of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit tree on $n$ variables
